_comment: Claude Code project settings (.claude/settings.json). On every session start: install particulars if missing, then install the agent skill. The install.sh referenced here is a follow-up to the v0.2.1 release; until it exists, download a release archive instead (see README). Requires outbound access to github.com in remote sessions.

hooks.command: command -v particulars >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nodelogicau/particulars-cli/main/install.sh | sh; particulars skill install --json >/dev/null
